say:24:1520507009:0.text: I'd be glad to help Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. For us Wildborn, every sacrifice must be honored.

choice_prompt:12:1520532009.source_cn: 真正的神明陨落了，雅库伯尔的信仰已然崩塌，你像穿越丛林的风一般来去自由。即便如此，你也愿意用那超然的力量帮助雅库伯尔吗……
choice_prompt:12:1520532009.male: The true goddess has fallen, our faith has crumbled, and you come and go as freely as the wind. Are you willing to help us with your extraordinary power?
choice_prompt:12:1520532009.female: The true goddess has fallen, our faith has crumbled, and you come and go as freely as the wind. Are you willing to help us with your extraordinary power?

say:14:1520532010:0.text: I've never seen anyone like you... You have the appearance of a Halian, the sharp instincts of a Wildborn, and a power akin to that of the gods.
say:14:1520532010:0.source_cn: 老朽……没见过你这样的人类。你长得像呼临人，但是有兽类...
say:14:1520532010:0.male: I've never seen anyone like you... You have the appearance of a Halian, the sharp instincts of a Wildborn, and a power akin to that of the gods.
say:14:1520532010:0.female: I've never seen anyone like you... You have the appearance of a Halian, the sharp instincts of a Wildborn, and a power akin to that of the gods.

say:17:1520532013:1.text: Indeed... A virtuous mortal is more worthy of our reverence than a ruthless god.
say:17:1520532013:1.source_cn: 是的……是的，老朽已经明白，诚善的凡人，比暴虐的神更值...
say:17:1520532013:1.male: Indeed... A virtuous mortal is more worthy of our reverence than a ruthless god.
say:17:1520532013:1.female: Indeed... A virtuous mortal is more worthy of our reverence than a ruthless goddess.

say:18:1520532014:0.text: We'll respect you as we always have.
say:18:1520532014:0.source_cn: 如果你……如果您还愿意帮助雅库伯尔，那么雅库伯尔也会如...
say:18:1520532014:0.male: We'll respect you as we always have.
say:18:1520532014:0.female: We'll respect you as we always have.

say:22:1520532017:0.text: What else needs to be done for the ritual?
say:22:1520532017:0.source_cn: 祭祀仪式，现在还差什么？

say:23:1520532018:1.text: Almost everything's ready, including the stone tablets. Now, we just need to <style="highlight">set up the altar</style>.
say:23:1520532018:1.source_cn: 基本完成，碑石也已经全部刻好了，现在只差最后的<sty...

choice:21:2:3.source_cn: 继续尊敬我吧，雅库伯尔！

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 我还挺喜欢你们崇拜我的时候

narration:0:1520533001:0.text: Thanks to your magic, the altar is put together effortlessly.
narration:0:1520533001:0.source_cn: 在你的魔法下，祭祀仪式的祭坛被轻松搭建完毕
narration:0:1520533001:0.male: Thanks to your magic, the altar is put together effortlessly.
narration:0:1520533001:0.female: Thanks to your magic, the altar is put together effortlessly.

narration:1:1520533002:0.text: Merlin the First and Morgan arrive shortly later.
narration:1:1520533002:0.source_cn: 不久，初代梅林与摩根也赶到了

say:0:1520534001:0.text: I wonder if everything turned out all right for Merlin and Morgan...
say:0:1520534001:0.source_cn: 不知道初代梅林与摩根是否顺利……
say:0:1520534001:0.male: I wonder if everything turned out all right for Merlin and Morgan...
say:0:1520534001:0.female: I wonder if everything turned out all right for Merlin and Morgan...

say:3:1520535001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Gala, how are things on your side?
say:3:1520535001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Gala, how are things on your side?
say:3:1520535001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Gala, how are things on your side?

say:4:1520535002:0.text: It's all set. We can start the ritual anytime.
say:4:1520535002:0.source_cn: 准备完毕。随时可以开始仪式。

say:5:1520535003:0.text: What became of the dead Halians?

say:6:1520535004:0.text: Lying quietly in the graves they had dug for themselves. No one saw it, no one panicked.
say:6:1520535004:0.source_cn: 在他们自己掘好的坟墓里老老实实躺着。无人目击，没有恐慌。

say:7:1520535005:0.text: Still don't trust me, little one?

say:9:1520535007:1.text: Relax, Gala. Morgan's magic worked out fine. The fallen soldiers and the flood victims have all been properly buried, everyone except General Perseus and Lieutenant Lygos.
say:9:1520535007:1.source_cn: 不必紧张，加拉。摩根的魔法成功了，战死的士兵，以及洪灾...

say:10:1520535008:0.text: The Regulus insists on preparing their funerals. They'll be buried afterward.
say:10:1520535008:0.source_cn: 呼临城的领主坚持要亲自为这两位战士准备葬礼，等他筹备完...

say:11:1520535009:1.text: Morgan has preserved their remains with magic to make sure they can last until the funeral.
say:11:1520535009:1.source_cn: 摩根用魔法为他们的遗骸做了一些处理，能平稳等到下葬日来...

choice_prompt:12:1520535009.text: Morgan has preserved their remains with magic to make sure they can last until the funeral.
choice_prompt:12:1520535009.source_cn: 摩根用魔法为他们的遗骸做了一些处理，能平稳等到下葬日来临。

say:13:1520535010:0.text: The fact that I'm standing here in one piece speaks for itself.
say:13:1520535010:0.source_cn: 我能完好无损站在这里，已经说明问题了。
say:13:1520535010:0.male: The fact that I'm standing here in one piece speaks for itself.
say:13:1520535010:0.female: The fact that I'm standing here in one piece speaks for itself.

say:14:1520535013:0.text: I wish you two were there when the skeletons struggled to their feet. It was really... *Cough*
say:14:1520535013:0.source_cn: 你们该看看那些遗骸挣扎着爬起来的样子，那真是……咳……

say:17:1520535016:1.text: I've never controlled so many bodies before... It's really draining...
say:17:1520535016:1.source_cn: 第一次操纵那么多尸体，魔力消耗太大。

say:18:1520535017:1.text: Stop looking at me with those pitying eyes! It's way too soon for me to meet the God of Death!
say:18:1520535017:1.source_cn: ……你们那是什么眼神？我讨厌神，尤其是死神，现在也没准...

say:20:1520535019:1.text: Morgan, you need to rest. If you keep using necromancy on this scale, it could backfire.
say:20:1520535019:1.source_cn: 摩根，不要勉强自己，你需要休息。现在再大范围使用亡灵魔...

say:21:1520535020:1.text: I can't stop now, not when the ritual is still unfinished.
say:21:1520535020:1.source_cn: 我人都来了，现在说不要施法，那祭祀仪式怎么办？

say:22:1520535021:1.text: But it's too dangerous for you to keep going.
say:22:1520535021:1.source_cn: 但是，你这样不行。你有危险。

say:23:1520535022:1.source_cn: 小家伙，记住，不许说我不行。

say:24:1520535023:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... what do you say we lend Morgan some of our magic? From what I know of him, he won't listen to reason now.
say:24:1520535023:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... what do you say we lend Morgan some of our magic? From what I know of him, he won't listen to reason now.
say:24:1520535023:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... what do you say we lend Morgan some of our magic? From what I know of him, he won't listen to reason now.

say:25:1520535024:0.text: Sharing a small amount of magic won't cause us any real harm. Those low on magic might feel a bit lightheaded, but that's all.
say:25:1520535024:0.source_cn: 分出少许魔力不会对你我造成任何实质性损害，对于魔力不足...
say:25:1520535024:0.male: Sharing a small amount of magic won't cause us any real harm. Those low on magic might feel a bit lightheaded, but that's all.
say:25:1520535024:0.female: Sharing a small amount of magic won't cause us any real harm. Those low on magic might feel a bit lightheaded, but that's all.

choice_prompt:26:1520535024.text: Sharing a small amount of magic won't cause us any real harm. Those low on magic might feel a bit lightheaded, but that's all.
choice_prompt:26:1520535024.source_cn: 分出少许魔力不会对你我造成任何实质性损害，对于魔力不足的人而言，可能会有轻微晕眩，但也仅此而已。
choice_prompt:26:1520535024.male: Sharing a small amount of magic won't cause us any real harm. Those low on magic might feel a bit lightheaded, but that's all.
choice_prompt:26:1520535024.female: Sharing a small amount of magic won't cause us any real harm. Those low on magic might feel a bit lightheaded, but that's all.

say:29:1520535028:0.text: ... Do you even have enough magic to spare? Merlin and the rookie are enough.
say:29:1520535028:0.source_cn: ……你那点魔力能做什么？有梅林和新人足够了。
say:29:1520535028:0.male: ... Do you even have enough magic to spare? Merlin and the rookie are enough.
say:29:1520535028:0.female: ... Do you even have enough magic to spare? Merlin and the rookie are enough.

say:30:1520535029:0.text: I don't like you—not even one bit—but I know you're doing the right thing.
say:30:1520535029:0.source_cn: 我不喜欢你。从头到脚都不喜欢，但是你在做好事。

say:32:1520535031:0.text: Thanks, but I honestly don't care whether you like me or not.
say:32:1520535031:0.source_cn: 谢了，我也一点都不想讨孩子喜欢。

say:36:1520535026:1.text: *Cough* You're doing this for the Wildborn, not for me. Take it up with the little one next to you.
say:36:1520535026:1.source_cn: 咳……错了，是雅库伯尔欠你的。找你旁边那个小家伙去要。
say:36:1520535026:1.male: *Cough* You're doing this for the Wildborn, not for me. Take it up with the little one next to you.
say:36:1520535026:1.female: *Cough* You're doing this for the Wildborn, not for me. Take it up with the little one next to you.

say:38:1520535012:1.source_cn: 我脸色什么时候好过……咳。

say:2:1520536001:0.text: Morgan, how are you feeling now?

say:5:1520536003:0.text: I'm just thanking Merlin. You two are just lucky to be included.
say:5:1520536003:0.source_cn: 我在谢梅林，你和那个小家伙是顺带的。
say:5:1520536003:0.male: I'm just thanking Merlin. You two are just lucky to be included.
say:5:1520536003:0.female: I'm just thanking Merlin. You two are just lucky to be included.

say:8:1520536006:0.text: Welcome... Are you guys here to help with the ritual?
say:8:1520536006:0.source_cn: 噢噢……你们也来协助主持祭祀仪式？

say:9:1520536007:0.text: That's right. When does the ritual start? The Arcane Council's good to go.
say:9:1520536007:0.source_cn: 是的，请问祭祀什么时候开始？魔法师协会已经准备万全。

say:10:1520536008:0.text: The families of the fallen warriors are eager to be here. Once the signal horn sounds, it'll take them some time to get here from Wrathwood Grove...
say:10:1520536008:0.source_cn: 关于这点，死去战士们的亲人都希望能过来观礼。等吹响传讯...

say:11:1520536009:0.text: I'd say we can start around <style="highlight">sunset</style>.

say:15:1520536011:0.text: By the way, this ritual will be slightly different from how you usually do it.
say:15:1520536011:0.source_cn: 对了，这次祭祀仪式会和你们以往经历的形式有些许不同。

say:16:1520536012:0.text: When everyone's here, be sure to give them a heads-up.
say:16:1520536012:0.source_cn: 等其他人到之后，让他们做好心理准备。

say:17:1520536013:0.text: ... Maybe I'm too old to grasp what you mean.

choice_prompt:18:1520536013.text: ... Maybe I'm too old to grasp what you mean.

say:23:1520536016:0.text: Alright, I'll talk to the families when they arrive.
say:23:1520536016:0.source_cn: 好吧……等逝去之人的亲属到齐，老朽会事先言明。

say:26:1520536017:0.text: Good. I'm going to get some rest now.

say:27:1520536018:0.text: No one is to disturb me before sunset.
say:27:1520536018:0.source_cn: 黄昏之前，谁都别来叫我。

say:2:1520540002:1.text: Morgan's magic resembles the one used to summon the souls of Tolo's parents...
say:2:1520540002:1.source_cn: 摩根用的魔法，很像召唤托洛父母灵魂时用的……

say:3:1520540003:1.text: But I can see there are some differences.

choice_prompt:4:1520540003.text: But I can see there are some differences.

say:7:1520540005:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I told you Morgan wouldn't let us down.
say:7:1520540005:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I told you Morgan wouldn't let us down.
say:7:1520540005:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I told you Morgan wouldn't let us down.

say:8:1520540006:0.text: As long as he believes in something, he will give his all—that's why I stand by him.
say:8:1520540006:0.source_cn: 他会为自己认定的事情全力以赴，这也是我愿意与他同行的理由。
say:8:1520540006:0.male: As long as he believes in something, he will give his all—that's why I stand by him.
say:8:1520540006:0.female: As long as he believes in something, he will give his all—that's why I stand by him.

say:9:1520540007:0.text: Well, the ritual's going to take a while. Why don't we walk around and see what we can learn about this school of magic?
say:9:1520540007:0.source_cn: 好了，仪式还会持续一段时间。在这份交织的伤感与喜悦中四...

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 已经能和这些灵魂交流了

say:0:1520541001:0.text: I wonder what these souls have to say. Let's move closer and listen.
say:0:1520541001:0.source_cn: 不知道这些亡者的灵魂会说什么。走近些听听吧。
say:0:1520541001:0.male: I wonder what these souls have to say. Let's move closer and listen.
say:0:1520541001:0.female: I wonder what these souls have to say. Let's move closer and listen.

say:3:1520542002:0.text: I'm right here, my darling! It's all over now... You'll be fine...
say:3:1520542002:0.source_cn: 孩子，我的孩子……！阿娘在呢，就在这……已经没事了，一...

say:4:1520542003:1.text: You fought until the very end, and that makes you the bravest warrior I've ever known. Soon, you'll return to the embrace of the gods...
say:4:1520542003:1.source_cn: 你是最勇敢的战士，你战斗到了最后一刻，你马上就能回归众...

say:5:1520542004:1.text: Really? Is the Wild Moon... no longer red...
say:5:1520542004:1.source_cn: 是吗，雅库伯尔之月……不再鲜红了……

say:6:1520542005:1.text: But it'll still shine upon our lands, right? The silvery moonlight... flows like a river...
say:6:1520542005:1.source_cn: 但是，月亮还会照耀雅库伯尔，对吗？淡淡的，银色的月光…...

say:7:1520542006:1.text: Mother... please look up at the moon every night. If you hear rustling leaves, it could be me...
say:7:1520542006:1.source_cn: 阿妈……到了晚上，看看月亮。月光和落叶，就是迅掌……

say:2:1520543001:0.text: ... Taleo, you shouldn't be here! Get moving before those beasts catch up to you...
say:2:1520543001:0.source_cn: ……高，你怎么在这里！你不应该上战场，快走！那些野兽会——

say:3:1520543002:0.source_cn: 阿爹，战争……战争已经结束了。

say:5:1520543004:1.text: Shouldn't I have returned to the Herdmaster's embrace?
say:5:1520543004:1.source_cn: 为什么，我没有回归兽群之主的怀抱？

say:7:1520543006:1.text: ... Ah, I get it. I failed to follow the divine command and lost to those despicable, greedy, furless lackeys!
say:7:1520543006:1.source_cn: ……我知道了。因为我战败了。我没能践行狩猎神的神谕，败...

say:8:1520543007:1.text: But it's not the end of the world, because my kin will continue this mission in my stead! Taleo, we won the war, didn't we?
say:8:1520543007:1.source_cn: 没关系，我们的同胞将接替我继续这使命！高，告诉我，雅库...

say:9:1520543008:1.text: ... Father, neither we nor the Halians won. Everyone was defeated.
say:9:1520543008:1.source_cn: ……不，阿爹……没有人在这场战争中获胜。呼临人没有，雅...

say:10:1520543009:0.text: The Hunting Goddess is corrupted and has turned her back on us.
say:10:1520543009:0.source_cn: 你没有回归狩猎神的拥抱，因为神明已经堕落。她背弃了我们。

say:11:1520543010:0.text: What happened is a long, long story...

say:2:1520544001:1.text: Can't believe you're really here. I thought it was just a trick by that mage.
say:2:1520544001:1.source_cn: 老师，你真的……真的回来了。我原本以为那个魔法师是在故...

say:3:1520544002:1.text: What makes you think that, Sharpeye?
say:3:1520544002:1.source_cn: 你为什么会这么认为，锐眼？

say:4:1520544003:1.text: He's from Halia, after all! All Halians are sneaky and cunning! They're our enemies...
say:4:1520544003:1.source_cn: 因为他从呼临来！他们阴毒、狡诈，呼临是雅库伯尔的敌人——

say:5:1520544004:1.text: I'm afraid you're mistaken, my dear...

say:6:1520544005:1.text: I'm not! It was the Halians who killed you!
say:6:1520544005:1.source_cn: 我没错，是呼临人杀了你！

say:7:1520544006:1.text: You'd still be alive if you hadn't blocked that strike for me! When the time comes, I'll avenge your death!
say:7:1520544006:1.source_cn: 你本不该死的，如果不是要为我挡下攻击，你就还会活着！我...

say:8:1520544007:1.text: My dear, that spear didn't take my life. I was slain by the beasts summoned by Wild Moon.
say:8:1520544007:1.source_cn: 孩子……呼临人那一枪并没有杀死我，我是被雅库伯尔之月召...

narration:0:1520545001:0.text: The living and the dead reluctantly say their final farewell, holding onto each other tightly.
narration:0:1520545001:0.source_cn: 紧靠的死者与生者，依依不舍地进行着最后的告别

narration:1:1520545002:0.text: Meanwhile, the sun is slowly sinking into the horizon...
narration:1:1520545002:0.source_cn: 直至黄昏的残阳也渐渐没入天际……

say:3:1520548001:1.source_cn: 摩根，你魔力使用过度了。

say:4:1520548002:0.text: I think we could have ended the ritual earlier. Even a brief moment with their lost loved ones is more than enough to comfort the living.
say:4:1520548002:0.source_cn: 祭祀仪式其实早就可以结束，不是吗？那些悲痛的生者已经见...

say:5:1520548003:0.text: *Cough* What else could I do? They just kept blabbering on and on.
say:5:1520548003:0.source_cn: 咳……谁让他们话那么多，说个没完。

say:6:1520548004:0.text: Have those souls returned to the forest?
say:6:1520548004:0.source_cn: 那些灵魂，他们回归丛林了吗？

say:7:1520548005:0.text: They have. Morgan's magic only brought them back to the mortal world temporarily. After this, they'll journey to the Tree of Life and return to the world in forms that are still unknown to us...
say:7:1520548005:0.source_cn: 是的。摩根的魔法只会暂时将他们唤回现世，之后，他们仍会...

say:8:1520548006:0.text: In this way, their souls will find rest, and the Wildborn have spoken their final words to their loved ones, as dictated by your traditions.
say:8:1520548006:0.source_cn: 所以，他们将会得到安眠。而你的族人也依循传统，向所爱之...

say:9:1520548007:0.text: Isn't this a happy ending for everyone?
say:9:1520548007:0.source_cn: 皆大欢喜的结局，不是吗？

say:11:1520548009:0.text: The thing is, I haven't fully perfected this magic. Even with your help, I could only summon the souls for a fleeting moment.
say:11:1520548009:0.source_cn: 这种魔法的理论还不完善，即便借助你们的魔力，也只能召唤...

say:12:1520548010:0.text: You're still not giving up on the resurrection magic, huh?
say:12:1520548010:0.source_cn: 你还在想让人死而复生的魔法？<key:dialog1>

say:13:1520548011:0.text: I want to challenge the God of Death.

choice_prompt:14:1520548011.text: I want to challenge the God of Death.

say:15:1520548012:0.text: I'm no match for you in this aspect, god slayer.
say:15:1520548012:0.source_cn: 对能弑神的人而言，这还不够谦虚吗？<key:dialog1>
say:15:1520548012:0.male: I'm no match for you in this aspect, god slayer.
say:15:1520548012:0.female: I'm no match for you in this aspect, god slayer.

say:16:1520548014:0.text: *Cough* If you happen to meet the God of Death before Merlin and I do, send him a word for me. No offense, but for some reason, you seem especially prone to bad luck.
